description: Ask what to implement for a goal in plain words, e.g. 'let agents pay per request', 'stop AI training crawls', 'let ChatGPT call my API'. Input: question; optional use_case (one of the 15 use-case ids in the schema) and audience. Returns the matched use case(s), up to 8 standards ranked by fit, maturity and adoption with reasons, do_this_first (prerequisites first), deprecated standards to avoid, and related ones to consider (also_consider carries id, name, step and question).
name: ask
